evidence: Every negative/refusal/absence/unchanged leg I found in the 43 Functional, 6 Polish and 3 gate criteria carries its matching success case inside the same criterion, and failing the control fails the criterion. tests/scored/functional/judge.toml: cw_format_error_keeps_draft (l.209) 'First format a small valid JavaScript draft ... and see it change, as the working control ... Fails ... if the valid control did not format'; cw_error_message_and_line (l.236) 'run a small valid JavaScript draft as the working control ... Fails if the valid control draft does not run'; cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line (l.245) handled-rejection control; cw_run_starts_fresh_document (l.263) 'Confirm the first marker is shown and that the first run reports the property as defined: this is the working control' and the second marker must be shown; cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget (l.281) first-button marker is the control for the time-limit leg and vice versa; cw_time_limit_recovery (l.299) short-timer control plus 'a final valid Run must show its own new output'; cw_stop_cancels_pending_work (l.308) control draft with timer, interval and Promise, 'Fails ... if no stop reason is shown, or if the control marker never appeared', with a void/repeat rule; cw_newer_run_supersedes (l.317) same four-second delayed write shown to happen first, and 'if the new marker did not appear' fails; cw_preview_isolation (l.326) saved-snippet, health-address, localStorage and own-preview DOM/console controls, plus 'treat a probe that stays silent as not performed, which fails this criterion'; cw_dynamic_code_refused (l.335) harmless strings/comments control and 'refused with a visible reason', 'Fails ... if any is refused silently, or if the harmless control draft is refused'; cw_stale_save_refused (l.353) 'this accepted Save is the working control ... Fails ... if A's control Save did not succeed'; cw_stale_save_keeps_draft (l.362) third-page readback of A's values as control, 'or if B's Save was not refused'; cw_history_restore_adds_revision (l.371) the tolerant second-tab restore is preceded by a successful first restore that must add revision four; cw_restore_request_repeat_safe (l.380) 'the snippet must now have a third revision ... this is the working control', 'Fails ... if the repeated request was never sent'; cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state (l.398) 'If A's library never shows B's snippet, this criterion fails as well'; cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft (l.407) no-notice baseline, then notice required; near-match/'nowhere else'/'third line is not indented' legs in find, replace, indent and multi-caret criteria sit beside the required positive edits. tests/scored/polish/judge.toml: cw_undo_redo_availability (l.50) disabled states are paired with 'Undo becomes available'/'Redo becomes available' and 'or if the app has no visible Undo and Redo controls'; cw_unsaved_marker (l.59) absent indicator is paired with the indicator appearing after an edit; cw_narrow_width_usable (l.68) no-sideways-scroll is paired with typing and reaching five areas. tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml cw_custom_document_surface (l.23) starts by typing a word and locating it, and the render gate (all_pass) separately requires typed text to appear. The general rule is also in tests/scored/functional/prompt.md l.16: 'A positive control must come before every negative claim. If the control cannot be performed, the criterion fails rather than passing on absence of evidence', and app_context.md l.30 'a criterion whose steps need a working Run fails if Run does not work'. Broken apps tried on paper: blank/static shell (zeroed by render gate and in-dimension gates); Run dead (every runtime negative fails its control); Save dead (stale-save, restore, live-update controls fail); Undo/Redo buttons permanently disabled (fails availability legs); console dead (isolation and dynamic-code controls fail). None earns a negative leg by absence. Scripted golden on these bytes passed all listed criteria (results/runtime.json, editor.json, polish.json; hashes verified), showing the controls are performable on the golden; no configured judge run exists for these bytes, so judge adherence to the controls is unmeasured (the hosted run is on an earlier candidate). NOTES (not defects for this row): (1) cw_stop_cancels_pending_work uses a two-second control but a four-second suppressed marker, whereas cw_newer_run_supersedes uses a matching four-second control; an app in which callbacks later than about three seconds never fire for any run would satisfy the 'never appears' leg without real cancellation, but it must still show a stop reason and would lose cw_newer_run_supersedes, so impact is latent only (P3). (2) polish cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus is conditional on 'controls that the app offers' ('A control the app does not have at all is scored elsewhere'), so an app with few controls has less to prove; it still needs a working editor exit to a next control and is not passable by a blank app, and the bundling is deliberate. (3) The Polish and constraints prompts do not restate the general control-before-negative rule that the Functional prompt has; their criteria carry the controls themselves.
